reviewScope: All 171 extant bilingual units and 5,520 Arabic punctuation-derived segments have recorded comparative decisions against retained electronic Arabic; unresolved readings remain explicit. This is not independent manuscript collation or human specialist certification.
sourceBasis: Current repository JS matn/commentary modules, retained edition N introduction and edition A main/conclusion
method: Model-assisted editorial comparison, not proportional automatic alignment. The 86 inherited records are retained as prior project review, not independently human-certified. Punctuation fragments may include quotation ellipses and are not always syntactic clauses.
